page_title: MON 3-2 BRE | Monaco v Brest 22/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Thomas Leonard has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' 3 - 2 Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) latched on to a brilliant cross and struck a perfect header inside the left post. The goalkeeper had no chance.
90+5' Mama Balde (Brest) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
90+4' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

90+4' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Brest.
90+2' Substitution. Kassoum Ouattara (Monaco) in, Aleksandr Golovin out.

90+1' 3 - 1 What a goal that is! Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) received the ball on the edge of the 18-yard box and spotted the goalkeeper off his line. He set himself up perfectly and lobbed the ball over Marco Bizot and into the net. George Ilenikhena provided the assistance. 3:1.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' A cross from a corner kick by Brest is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

89' Jordan Amavi (Brest) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. Brest earn a corner.
89' The resulting set piece from Brest is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
88' Kenny Lala (Brest) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Brest have a corner.
87' Mama Balde (Brest) meets a cross inside the box, but Radoslaw Majecki wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone.
85' Today's referee Thomas Leonard rightly decides to book Wilfried Singo (Monaco) for his harsh tackle.
84' George Ilenikhena (Monaco) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
83' Thomas Leonard shows a yellow card to Julien Le Cardinal (Brest), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
81' Here comes a substitution. Hugo Magnetti is given a rest as he is replaced by Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest).
81' The substitution has been made. Jonas Martin (Brest) has replaced Mahdi Camara.
80' Vanderson is substituted due to injury. Adi Hutter gives a chance to Wilfried Singo (Monaco).
80' Eliesse Ben Seghir will be replaced by Jordan Teze (Monaco).
79' Vanderson (Monaco) picks up an injury.
78' Thomas Leonard has issued a yellow card to Radoslaw Majecki (Monaco).
78' Mama Balde (Brest) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
77' Jordan Amavi (Brest) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.
74' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) takes the corner but it's cleared.
74' Mama Balde (Brest) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
73' Eric Roy has decided to substitute Abdallah Sima and he is replaced by Mama Balde (Brest).
70' Brendan Chardonnet (Brest) brings his opponent down. Thomas Leonard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
68' Substitution. Breel Embolo makes way for George Ilenikhena (Monaco).
67' Referee Thomas Leonard has finally had enough of Eric Roy and gives him a straight RED CARD!
64' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
61' The Monaco players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Thomas Leonard. NO PENALTY!
60' Celebrations by Monaco are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
60' Referee Thomas Leonard sees the trip by Marco Bizot (Brest) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Monaco!
57' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monaco comes to nothing.
57' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Monaco.
56' The corner from Kamory Doumbia (Brest) is intercepted by Radoslaw Majecki.
56' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Kamory Doumbia (Brest). Brest force their opponents to concede a corner.
50' 2 - 1 Abdallah Sima (Brest) rises high to head the corner in the net and beyond the goalkeeper.
50' The referee blows his whistle, Brest are awarded a corner kick.

49' The Brest players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball. The ball goes out for a corner. Brest can continue in their attacking effort.
46' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) manages to beat his opponent to the ball, but he commits a foul in the process.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Eric Roy probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Romain Del Castillo. He is replaced by Kamory Doumbia (Brest).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+5' CHANCE! Breel Embolo (Monaco) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
45+2' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) brings an opponent down and Thomas Leonard interrupts the game.
45+2' A corner kick by Brest is thwarted by the well prepared Radoslaw Majecki (Monaco).
45+1' Abdallah Sima (Brest) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. Corner kick. Brest will have an opportunity.
45+1' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The linesman signals a throw-in for Brest.
44' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) sends a cross into the box, but Radoslaw Majecki comes off his line to gather the ball.
42' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Thomas Leonard blows for a foul.

41' Good clearance! Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brest.
40' Neat link-up play between Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) and Denis Zakaria, but Marco Bizot reads the game well and the move breaks down.
38' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
37' Looks like Denis Zakaria (Monaco) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

36' Julien Le Cardinal (Brest) out-muscles his marker and gets the ball from the corner kick. He produces a shot, but it goes way wide of the left post. High, wide and not pretty at all. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
36' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
36' Abdallah Sima (Brest) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Brest force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
35' Abdallah Sima (Brest) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
34' Brest are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence. The ball is out of play. Brest will have a throw-in.

30' Ludovic Ajorque (Brest) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends a bullet header narrowly over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Monaco will have a goal kick.

30' Kenny Lala (Brest) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession. The ball is behind the touchline and Brest will take a throw-in.
29' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Thomas Leonard no option but to blow his whistle.
27' Christian Mawissa Elebi (Monaco) serves up a nice cross, but Marco Bizot punches the ball away.
26' Kenny Lala (Brest) handles the ball inside the box. Monaco get a free kick.

24' 2 - 0 Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) makes himself some space on the edge of the penalty area and pulls the trigger. His accurate effort goes off the post into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:0.
22' Eric Roy is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) suffers an injury and Edimilson Fernandes comes on.

20' The cross into the penalty area from Hugo Magnetti (Brest) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Monaco.
17' Mahdi Camara (Brest) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Radoslaw Majecki intercepts the ball.
16' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
15' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
15' Some great controlled play and passing from Monaco. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
13' Jordan Amavi (Brest) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Thomas Leonard stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
10' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

10' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
9' It looks like Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) saw red with that tackle. Thomas Leonard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
6' The main referee, Thomas Leonard, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Kenny Lala (Brest) is given a yellow card for dissent.

5' 1 - 0 Goal! Eliesse Ben Seghir displays great vision and sends a pass to Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 1:0.
2' Kenny Lala (Brest) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
1' Monaco hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Monaco will have the kick-off.
Thomas Leonard will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
